clauses.heading: Definitions
clauses.text: "Effective Date" means the date of signing.

clauses.heading: Payment
clauses.text: Buyer shall pay invoices within 30 days of the Effective Date.

clauses.heading: Penalty
clauses.text: A penalty applies if payment under Clause 5 is late.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate with 30 days notice. Clause 9 penalties survive termination.

clauses.heading: Governing Law
clauses.text: This agreement is governed by the laws of India.
